name: local-trace-distiller
description: Local trace distillation tools and skill workflow for deriving experimental skills from private session traces.

interface.shortDescription: Derive experimental skills from local traces
interface.longDescription: Searches local captured session traces, clusters recurring patterns, and runs the existing Jinn distillation flow using the user's selected LLM provider.
defaultPrompt: Use /distill to derive an experimental skill from local traces.
